title: Oil Red O Staining
author: Yuejun Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iemcbc6

steps.title: Induce Adipogenesis
steps.instruction: Grow cells in the adipose-inducing medium for 2-3 weeks.

steps.title: Fix Cells
steps.instruction: Fix the cells using 10% formalin for at least 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Stain with Oil Red O
steps.instruction: Stain the cells using a working solution of 60% Oil Red O in isopropanol for 10 min.

steps.title: Quantify Stained Cells
steps.instruction: Determine the proportion of Oil Red O-positive cells by counting them under a light microscope.

steps.title: Normalize OD Values
steps.instruction: Normalize the final OD value in each group using the total protein concentrations prepared from a duplicate plate.
